settlement.rationale: Storm damage to the roof, ceiling and carpets is covered under Section 2 (Insured Events — Storm) of your policy. The claimed amount of $550.00 for the garden pergola was declined, as free-standing structures not attached to the home are excluded under Section 4.3. Your policy excess of $500.00 has been deducted from the assessed amount.
